description: This file defines a template class 'EnumerateType' for handling enum-to-string conversions, including methods for initialization, assignment, comparison, and lookup. It also defines macros for generating conversion tables and a struct 'EnumerateConversion' for mapping enum values to string names.

classes.name: EnumerateType
classes.description: A template class for managing enum values with string conversion capabilities, including various constructors, assignment operators, comparison operators, and lookup functions.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operator overloads for copying or assigning enum values, uint32_t, or text fragments.

methods.name: IsSet
methods.description: Checks if the enum value is set.

methods.name: Data
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the enum value.
